address: 30 Jalan Nyonya, off Jalan Pudu, Pudu, Kuala Lumpur, 55100, Malaysia
bio: Open for just a few hours a day, this stall attracts foodies in droves with its coveted siew yok – roast pork with crackling skin and succulent meat. Arrive early and wait for the pork to come out of the oven at noon sharp....
